intro: The Grand Skyseer is an introductory journey into the heart of Valanaar, directing travelers to seek an audience with Ayessa Dawnsinger at the Windshaper lodge. As tensions simmer between local factions and a shadowy cult threatens the region, the Windshapers urgently seek individuals gifted with spiritual sight.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now that you've arrived in Valanaar, you'll likely want to check in with the other members of the Windshapers here. The current Grand Skyseer and her people operate out of the lodge near the center of Valanaar.

You should also be aware, the Windshapers and High Order don't get along very well in these parts. Be careful and give the High Order a good, wide berth. We've got enough to worry about with the cult, I won't tolerate faction violence in the streets of Valanaar.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Elder Amberwind sent me a message about you and your exploits in Shen'dar Village. You are most welcome here, friend.

You have a strong aura, and you clearly have a resonance with the spirits. Fewer and fewer of us have the skysight of late, and Zephras needs those with the gift if we are to survive these trying times. I am glad you have found your way to me.
I look forward to further making your acquaintance.
